landscape.label: Rules to Know
landscape.title: Agoura Hills ADU rules to know

tiles.s: The most a city can require
Junior ADUs stay inside the house
Root zones drawn in; permit to dig inside

landscape.speak: A few rules to know. A city can require no more than four-foot side and rear setbacks. A city has sixty days to act on a complete application. A junior ADU tops out at five hundred square feet. And in Agoura Hills, every ADU site plan has to show the oak trees and their root zones.
landscape.say: A few rules to know. A city can require no more than 4-foot side and rear setbacks. A city has 60 days to act on a complete application. A junior ADU tops out at 500 square feet. And in Agoura Hills, every ADU site plan has to show the oak trees and their root zones.
